negative_source_proof.result: Pinned D1 TfxScope source contains no CBuffer index 10; no engine-facing API10 scope name may be inherited from it.

required_primary_observations: exact program identity (GCN SHA-256) at the draw/dispatch that consumes API10
shader stage and exact SGPR descriptor window used by that program
four descriptor dwords exactly as written to user-data SGPRs
command-buffer packet or equivalent primary writer bytes that establish those four dwords
writer callsite/provenance sufficient to distinguish command emission from later shader consumption
decoded descriptor base address only when the descriptor encoding itself is independently proven
backing allocation identity, byte range, and exact captured bytes covering every TBUFFER load used by the selected program
capture point/order tying descriptor write, backing bytes, and consuming draw/dispatch together

minimum_cross_family_capture.rule: Capture exact representatives spanning both descriptor windows and every observed TBUFFER instruction-count family before generalizing.

forbidden_inferences: Do not infer engine meaning from API number 10.
Do not infer engine meaning from SGPR window, TBUFFER count, ordering, adjacency, or slot reuse.
Do not promote a runtime writer name into an engine semantic without independent primary evidence.
Do not decode a GPU address from descriptor dwords until the applicable GCN descriptor encoding is pinned and proven.
Do not substitute host floating-point behavior for unresolved GCN behavior.
pivot_policy: If primary runtime capture is unavailable, preserve this blocker and continue a source-closed Destiny transaction elsewhere.
